city: Create original production environment artwork for Codematica's vertically scrolling zombie learning game. Use attached garden/canal/tower paintings as palette and architectural references. Output ONE very tall portrait image, ideally 1024x3072 (largest tall portrait supported). It is ONE CONTINUOUS landscape, not a collage, no panel divisions, no text, no interface, no markers, no characters. Orthographic elevated 2.5D story-map perspective throughout: NO SKY, NO HORIZON anywhere, no change of camera perspective. Painterly gouache, restrained soft textured shapes inspired by atmospheric watercolor adventure games. TOP THIRD: lavender slate ruined rooftops, a small warm-lit radio tower at upper right, cables and suspended terraces. MIDDLE THIRD: teal canal locks, copper pumps and arched stone bridges. BOTTOM THIRD: sage garden outpost, round repair workshop, herb beds and overgrown limestone courtyards. Connect these districts organically with a cream winding walking route down the central 45% of the entire image. Route exits top and bottom at center, shifts slightly left and right. Leave central space quiet and light for level buttons; key buildings, vegetation, pipes and lights cluster on left/right edges, not center. Buildings are small game-map landmarks, not huge foreground architecture. Transition rooftops into waterworks into garden through shared limestone terraces, turquoise channels, vegetation and thin wisps of mist; absolutely no horizontal district borders or changes of lighting. All regions lit softly from upper left, warm amber points of light. Preserve coherent miniature scale and cream/teal/sage/lavender palette. Avoid repeated identical structures. Fine edge details, large readable shapes. The entire artwork is connected ground terrain seen from above; top is also ground, never sky.
